clue.text: Destruction from heroin: millions perished

indicators.note: the millions have perished, so their letter is lost from the slang word

parts.note: smack is street slang for heroin
M is the standard abbreviation for million(s)

explanation.surface: A grim warning about the devastation drugs cause, with millions dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A sack is the plundering and wrecking of a captured town, so it means destruction.

clue.text: Climbed, securing power, and took the crown

indicators.note: the climbing word holds the power letter fast inside it

parts.note: scaled means climbed, as a wall or mountain
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Someone ascends, seizes power and is crowned king.
explanation.definitionFit: To scalp someone is to remove the top of the head, the crown, so it is a whimsical sense.

clue.text: About entrance to hell -—- nothing in it like a big pit

parts.note: C, for circa, means about

indicators.note: nothing is put inside the hell entrance itself

parts.note: Avernus, a lake near Naples, was the classical entrance to the underworld
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A description of the gaping mouth of the underworld, empty inside like a pit.
explanation.walkthrough: AVERNUS with O set inside becomes AVERNOUS, after C. Avernus is the Roman entrance to the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: Cavernous describes something huge and hollow, as a large pit is.

clue.text: Infectious person to catch this from supermarket?

parts.note: a carrier passes on a disease without suffering from it
to bag is to catch, as game

explanation.surface: Warning that a contagious shopper might pass something on to you.
explanation.definitionFit: Supermarkets hand out plastic sacks with handles to carry the shopping home.

clue.text: Surrounded by a fog, start to drive in

indicators.note: the start letter goes in among the letters of a fog

parts.note: mist is a thin fog

indicators.note: the start of the next word supplies its first letter

explanation.surface: A motorist begins driving while engulfed in thick fog.
explanation.definitionFit: Amidst is a preposition meaning in the middle of, so surrounded by.

clue.text: Using half of ticket, centre punched out changing stations

indicators.note: the middle letter is removed like a hole punched through a ticket

parts.note: a return ticket has two halves, and travelling back uses the second half

explanation.surface: A ticket inspector punches a hole in the middle of a return ticket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre punched out' removes R, the fifth of nine letters, from RETURNING.
explanation.definitionFit: Retuning a radio means moving it to a different station.

clue.text: At this rate, nothing in the world can stop us

definitions.text: At this rate, nothing in the world can stop us

parts.words: At this rate, nothing in the world can stop us
parts.note: read as a rocket's speed, at which the Earth's gravity can no longer hold it back

explanation.surface: A boast that, going on like this, we are unstoppable.
explanation.definitionFit: Physics names the speed needed to break free of a planet's gravitational pull.

clue.text: Feel miserable in one's cabin

definitions.meaning: on a ship, cabins lie beneath the deck

explanation.surface: A sailor sulks alone in their quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: Be low means feel down; below means under deck, where cabins are on board ship.

clue.text: Man taking grand female into love nest

parts.note: G is slang for a grand, a thousand
O is love, a zero score in tennis

indicators.note: the female letter goes inside the love nest

parts.note: a drey is a squirrel's nest

explanation.surface: A man brings an impressive woman back to his secret love nest.
explanation.walkthrough: F goes inside DREY, making DFREY, after G and O.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition by example: this is a traditional English given name borne by men, so any bearer is a man.

clue.text: Polish pianist I shoot, playing around clubs

indicators.note: the reworked letters go around the clubs letter
playing about with the letters rearranges them

parts.note: C is the card abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A violent confession about gunning down a Polish pianist near some nightclubs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality but means refinement; the pianist and the shooting are pure fodder for 'playing', with 'around' wrapping the clubs letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Polish here means refinement and elegance, which is what sophistication is.

clue.text: Parts of lungs I've all burst, inhaling oxygen

indicators.note: the burst letters breathe in the oxygen symbol
letters that burst are scattered into a new order

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A patient complains that their lungs have burst while breathing in oxygen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'burst' rearranges I'VE ALL and 'inhaling' takes in O.
explanation.definitionFit: Alveoli are the tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange happens.

clue.text: Pleased to be attracted to poacher

definitions.meaning: a poacher catches trout by stroking them by hand, luring the fish

explanation.surface: Someone is delighted to find themselves drawn to a rogue.
explanation.walkthrough: Tickling trout is an old poaching method: the fish is stroked underneath until it can be scooped out.
explanation.definitionFit: Tickled means amused, and also describes a trout lured out of the water by hand.

clue.text: Ability to afford the gas bill?

definitions.meaning: the real value of money, what it can buy
a gas bill is a charge for buying energy

explanation.surface: A worry about whether one can afford to pay for heating.
explanation.definitionFit: Economists use the phrase for what money can buy, and fuel bills buy energy.

clue.text: Liquid medication, having unknown medical condition

parts.note: drops are medicine given in liquid form
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A patient is on liquid medicine for a mysterious illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Dropsy is the old name for oedema, swelling from fluid build-up.

clue.text: How tea may be got from the bag, not in steady flow

definitions.text: How tea may be got from the bag
definitions.meaning: taking the odd-numbered letters of the words the bag gives T, E and A

explanation.surface: A tea bag that releases its brew in fits and starts.
explanation.walkthrough: The first, third and fifth letters of 'the bag' spell TEA: odd, so uneven, letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Unevenly means irregularly, not steadily.

clue.text: Lack of awareness spoils nice scene

indicators.note: spoiling the words wrecks their order

explanation.surface: Ignorance ruining a pleasant view.
explanation.definitionFit: Nescience is a formal word for ignorance, not knowing.

clue.text: Bully-boy shredded a beetle

parts.note: tore means ripped up
a dor is a kind of dung beetle

explanation.surface: A thug tearing a beetle to pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bully-boy' suggests a thug, but means a man who fights bulls.
explanation.definitionFit: A toreador is a bullfighter, so a man who deals with bulls.

clue.text: Attitude I assume as one divine

parts.note: a pose is a bodily attitude
to don is to put on or assume, as clothes

explanation.surface: A person adopting the manner of a god.
explanation.definitionFit: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea.

clue.text: Historian of ancient Egypt may have scratched its surface

definitions.text: Historian of ancient Egypt may have scratched its surface

parts.words: Historian of ancient Egypt may have scratched its surface
parts.note: read as the scribe writing on the reed sheet rather than a scholar probing a subject

explanation.surface: A modern Egyptologist only scratching the surface of the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Egyptian writers inscribed records on sheets made from the reed.

clue.text: To fail to break record

indicators.note: the failing word breaks open the record

parts.note: CD, compact disc, is a record
to lose is to fail to win

explanation.surface: Missing out on breaking a record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To' is the definition: a door pushed to is shut.
explanation.definitionFit: A door pulled to is shut, so to as an adverb means in the shut position.

clue.text: One that may be executed outside prison where one's helplessly thrown

indicators.note: the legal document goes outside the prison word

parts.note: a deed is a legal document that is executed, meaning signed and made valid
pen is slang for penitentiary, a prison

explanation.surface: A condemned man outside the jail, thrown into a hopeless position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executed' suggests a hanging, but a deed is executed by signing it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thrown in at the deep end is an idiom for facing a challenge without preparation.

clue.text: Friend crossing border first

indicators.note: the friend straddles the border, holding it inside

parts.note: pal means friend
a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A friend is the first to cross a border.
explanation.definitionFit: Primal means original or first in time.

clue.text: Basic army training that's professionally lucrative?

definitions.meaning: drill for a private, the lowest army rank
doctors or lawyers working for themselves rather than the state

explanation.surface: Wondering whether square-bashing could lead to a well-paid career.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a professional's own fee-paying work, and fancifully a private soldier's practice.

clue.text: Man off watch taking the wheel

definitions.meaning: a sailor who does no watches is called an ... at sea
an ... wheel transfers motion between other wheels

explanation.surface: A sailor off duty taking the helm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' is a link. At sea an idler is a crew member not keeping watches.
explanation.definitionFit: An idler is both a lazy person, or an off-watch sailor, and a gear wheel.

clue.text: Got better results at first in association

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: allied means joined in association

explanation.surface: A team improved its results once it joined a league.
explanation.definitionFit: Rallied means recovered, as a patient or market does.

clue.text: Show me a sharp point concealed

indicators.note: the word me hides the other letters inside it

parts.note: a tine is a prong, as on a fork

explanation.surface: A demand to see a hidden blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A matinee is an afternoon performance of a show.

clue.text: Well, turn pancake!

parts.note: a spring is a well of water
to roll is to turn over

explanation.surface: A cook telling a pancake to flip over.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring roll is a thin pancake rolled round a filling and fried.

clue.text: Hear not many died in conflict

indicators.note: tells us to listen to the sound of the phrase

parts.note: not many is few, and D is the abbreviation for died

explanation.surface: A report that few were killed in the fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A feud is a long-running bitter quarrel.
